title: WellaPath Nigeria facilities artifact — schema 2.0, GRID3 lineage (candidate)
description:
Schema for the GRID3-only nationwide facilities candidate. The RECORD shape is the schema-2.0 consumer contract: every field name and type a schema-2.0 reader (Mobile PR #79, Backend PR #36) accesses is present under the same name, so the reader needs no code change between the two 2.0 lineages. What differs is the truth the _metadata tells: this source has an established licence (CC BY 4.0, evidence vendored in-repo), a declared version and snapshot date, a named publisher, an attribution obligation — and no coordinate remediation, because its coordinates are accepted exactly as published or the row is quarantined; there is no swap rule and no corrected pair anywhere in this lineage.

Absence convention, unchanged from the sibling schema: null means NOT PROVIDED (the source has no such column, or the field was blank). The literal string "unknown" means the source explicitly recorded Unknown, which is a different statement. No absent value is ever represented as false, zero or an invented value. phone, opening_hours, emergency_capable, address, operational_status, registration_status, license_status, beds and every service flag are null on every record: GRID3 evidences none of them (emergency_capable additionally awaits FAC-D002's pending Clinical wording and is never populated). type is populated under the approved FAC-D001 mapping (2026-09-15) from facility_level_option only — {hospital, health_centre}, with the source's explicit Unknown staying null.

lineage.description: Pinned. Distinguishes this candidate from the NHFR-derived candidate held as audit evidence on PRs #40/#41; the two must never be confused, joined or merged.

may_publish.description: Pinned false. Source licensing is established for this lineage, but licensing clearance is not Product, Clinical or Engineering approval; FAC-D001..D006 are open.

states_covered.description: All 36 states plus the FCT. The count is pinned: losing a state must fail validation, not shrink a list.

organization.const: Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN), Columbia University

copyright.const: Copyright 2024. The Trustees of Columbia University in the City of New York.

citation.const: Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN), Columbia University 2024. GRID3 NGA - Health Facilities v2.0. New York: GRID3. https://doi.org/10.7916/kv1n-0743. Accessed 20 July 2026.

forbidden_sources.description: The NHFR internal export and everything derived from it. The isolation report proves, and the validator re-proves, that nothing in this artifact is sourced from any of them.

transformation.description: Pinned. GRID3 coordinates are accepted exactly as published or the row is quarantined. No pair is ever swapped, snapped, moved or fabricated in this lineage.

facility_id.description: ng_g3_ + the source's stable globalid (uuid: prefix stripped, lowercased). Distinct in shape from facilities 1.1's ng_<state>_<n> and the NHFR lineage's ng_nhf_<n>, so the three lineages can never be confused.

type.description: Populated under FAC-D001 (approved 2026-09-15) from source_record.facility_level_option ONLY — never from the facility name: the three Hospital source values -> hospital; Primary Health Center, Primary Health Clinic and Health Post -> health_centre; the source's explicit Unknown -> null. The enum pins the populated values to exactly what the decision approved; mapping any additional value requires a new Product decision AND a schema revision. A null type is not a vocabulary member and must never be filtered out or treated as one — null-type records remain visible and searchable.

city_area.description: The LGA name, as in the sibling lineage.

phone.description: Null on every record: GRID3 publishes no contact fields. Nothing is carried from any other source (FAC-D003).

opening_hours.description: Null on every record: GRID3 publishes no operating-hours field.

emergency_capable.description: Null on every record: GRID3 records no emergency capability, and none is inferred (FAC-D002).

address.description: Null on every record: GRID3 publishes no address field.

ownership_type.description: Source-faithful tokens. for_profit / not_for_profit are deliberately NOT prefixed private_: the source pairs 'For Profit' with Public ownership on 4 rows and 'Not For Profit' with Public on 10, so a private_ prefix would assert a pairing the source contradicts.

operational_status.description: Null on every record: GRID3 has no operational-status column. Null (not provided) is a different statement from the sibling lineage's 'unknown' (source said Unknown).

services.description: The consumer-contract shape with every value null: GRID3 records no service capability, and none is invented.

source_globalid.description: Verbatim as the source wrote it, uuid: prefix included where present, so a join back to the CSV is byte-exact.

nhfr_uid.description: GRID3's own published cross-reference to the national registry, carried verbatim FROM THE GRID3 FILE. It is licensed GRID3 content; nothing here was read from any NHFR export.

facility_level_option.description: The source's finer facility descriptor, whitespace-normalised, carried so the FAC-D001 type mapping can be reviewed and later applied against the very value each record holds. 'unknown' records the source's explicit Unknown.

coordinate_transformation.description: Pinned on every record. This lineage has no swap rule; latitude and longitude are the source's values exactly.
